# Sentra Technology (PT. Sentra Visi Teknologi)

> Sentra Technology is an Indonesian technology company headquartered in Samarinda, East Kalimantan, founded in 2019. It builds AI on top of existing CCTV (video analytics, PPE detection, face-recognition attendance), IoT and field hardware (smartlocks, GPS fleet telematics, sensors, networking), private on-premise LLMs, and custom enterprise software for government, universities, industry (mining, plantations, logistics), healthcare, and corporate clients across Indonesia and abroad.

Key facts:

- Legal name: PT. Sentra Visi Teknologi. Brand: Sentra Technology.
- Founded: 2019, Samarinda, East Kalimantan, Indonesia. Office: Kompleks Graha Indah A.13, Samarinda Kota.
- Team: 13 in-house experts (leadership, hardware division, software division). CEO: Muhammad Nabil Akbar Pratama. COO: Richard Chandra Tjiang.
- Track record: 50+ delivered projects. Clients include Pemerintah Kota Samarinda, Diskominfosandi Kabupaten Barito Utara, Universitas Mulawarman, Institut Teknologi Kalimantan, STT Migas Balikpapan, PT. Adhi Karya, PT Astra International Tbk, 1Ci Enterprise, and MBC Entertainment.
- Award: POMPy BATARA, a thematic map portal built by Sentra for Kabupaten Barito Utara, helped the regency win the Digital Innovation Award 2026.
- Working model: free initial consultation, then a measured 2–4 week pilot before rollout; full rollouts typically take 2–6 months. All products can run on-premise or in a private cloud; no vendor lock-in.
- Support: 100% in-house team based in Indonesia, SLA response time of 1–4 hours depending on tier, with on-site field teams for large deployments.
- Hardware partners: TP-Link VIGI (CCTV), Teltonika (GPS trackers), Lenovo, Starlink.
- Languages: Indonesian (default), English, Chinese, Korean, Malay.
- Contact: admin@sentratechnology.com (product contact: richard@sentratechnology.com), WhatsApp/phone +62 817-0822-552, https://www.sentratechnology.com/contact

## Services

- [CCTV Analytics](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/cctv-analytics): AI layer on existing CCTV that detects people, vehicles, restricted zones, and incidents, with real-time alerts.
- [Computer Vision](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/computer-vision): PPE/safety detection, face recognition, and text reading from cameras, trained on Indonesian field data.
- [Private LLM](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/private-llm): internal AI assistant that answers from company documents and runs on the client's own servers.
- [Infrastructure Installation](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/instalasi-infrastruktur): LAN and WiFi networks, fiber optics, server racks, device power, CCTV, and videotrons installed and maintained by Sentra's own field team in East Kalimantan.
- [Starlink for Business](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/starlink): Starlink kit procurement, site survey and mounting, site WiFi to offices and mess halls, off-grid solar power, and backup internet for mines, plantations, construction sites, vessels, villages, and branch offices.
- [CCTV Procurement & Installation](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/pengadaan-cctv): CCTV procurement and installation with TP-Link VIGI cameras and NVRs: site survey, camera point planning, cabling and PoE, remote viewing on phones, solar and 4G cameras for sites without power or cable, and maintenance, for offices, warehouses, factories, local government, schools, mines, and shops.
- [IT Procurement](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/pengadaan-it): procurement of business laptops, all-in-one and desktop PCs, tablets, servers, and workstations (Lenovo ThinkPad, ThinkCentre, ThinkSystem, HDe), with specification consulting, bulk delivery, OS and application setup, asset labeling, and after-sales support for companies, government agencies, schools, mines, and small businesses.
- [Android App Development](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/aplikasi-android): Android (and iOS) apps for companies and government built around field workflows: attendance, inspections, payroll slips, data collection, offline mode for sites without signal, admin web dashboards, integration with HRIS/ERP, Play Store publishing, and maintenance. Examples: HRIS Mobile for Bukit Baiduri Energi, Smart Attendance for Universitas Mulawarman.
- [IoT & Hardware](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/iot-hardware): smartlocks, fleet telematics, sensors, gateways, and networking, from site survey to maintenance.
- [Custom Software](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/custom-software): web and mobile applications built around a team's workflow.
- [System Integration](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/integrasi-sistem): connects ERP, HRIS, CCTV, and legacy databases via APIs, connectors, and SSO.
- [Data & Analytics](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/data-analytics): real-time dashboards, ETL, thematic maps, and media analytics.
- [Technology Consulting](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/services/konsultasi-teknologi): infrastructure assessment and 3–5 year digital transformation roadmaps.

## Products

- [Safety AI](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/produk/safety-ai): computer vision for occupational safety (K3/HSE), including PPE detection.
- [Attendance](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/produk/attendance): face-recognition attendance that prevents buddy punching and syncs with HRIS.
- [HRIS Sentra](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/produk/hris): end-to-end HR, leave, overtime, and payroll.
- [Smartlock](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/produk/smartlock): smart door access control.
- [Fleet](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/produk/fleet): GPS fleet telematics, fuel, and driver behavior monitoring.
- [sentrAI](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/produk/sentrai): on-premise private LLM.
- [Sentra Meeting](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/produk/meeting): enterprise video conferencing with recording and Indonesian transcription.
- [Integrasi](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/produk/integrasi), [Kiosk](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/produk/kiosk), [Invoice](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/produk/invoice), [Website](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/produk/website).
- [Device catalog](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/produk) and [VIGI CCTV catalog](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/katalog-cctv-vigi): procurement and installation of CCTV, GPS trackers, Starlink, laptops, servers, displays, and fiber.

## Selected projects

- [POMPy BATARA](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/portfolio/pompy-batara): thematic map portal for Diskominfosandi Kabupaten Barito Utara.
- [DAPODIK Geospatial Dashboard](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/portfolio/dashboard-geospasial-dapodik): education data mapping for Kabupaten Barito Utara.
- [Smart Attendance](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/portfolio/smart-attendance): face-recognition attendance at Universitas Mulawarman.
- [AI PPE Detection](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/portfolio/deteksi-apd-ai): safety detection for PT. Multi Harapan Utama.
- [Fleet Management System](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/portfolio/fleet-management): mining contractor in East Kalimantan.
- [HRIS Mobile & Payroll](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/portfolio/hris-mobile-payroll): Bukit Baiduri Energi.
- [All projects](https://www.sentratechnology.com/en/portfolio)
